intro.title: 4Sum
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that solves the 4Sum problem, finding all unique quadruplets in an array that sum to a given target value. You will learn the core concept of using two nested loops combined with a two-pointer technique to efficiently search for combinations without checking every possible set. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, loops, and conditional logic to handle duplicates and optimize performance. This exercise will help you understand how to break down complex problems into manageable steps and improve your algorithmic thinking skills.
intro.usecase: The 4Sum algorithm pattern is essential in data analysis and recommendation systems where you need to find combinations that meet specific criteria. For example, in financial portfolio optimization tools, analysts might use it to identify sets of four stocks whose combined risk metrics match a target threshold. In e-commerce platforms, this algorithm could help find product bundles where the total price equals a promotional discount target. Travel booking applications might use similar logic to find flight/hotel/car rental combinations that fit within a customer's budget constraints.
